title: Binance Will List Radicle (RAD)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list Radicle (RAD) and will open trading for RAD/BTC, RAD/BNB, RAD/BUSD, and RAD/USDT trading pairs at 2021-10-07 07:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  RAD  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for RAD will open at 2021-10-08 07:00 (UTC) Note: The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page. What is Radicle (RAD)? Radicle is a decentralized code collaboration network built on open protocols. It enables developers to collaborate on code without relying on trusted intermediaries. RAD is the governance token of the platform that enables communal ownership, collective governance, and long-term sustainability of the Radicle network. RAD Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
